# Codeply

> Codeply is ambient intelligence for your computer and phone: one personal AI agent that works at your desk, keeps going in the cloud when you leave, and calls you when it needs you. It writes and checks code in a real browser, runs bots for your inbox and calendar, and is free to start. Apps for Windows, macOS, iPhone, Android, VS Code and the terminal.

Codeply is one product with several surfaces that share the same account, memory and agent. Latest release: Codeply 2.3 (October 30, 2026). The desktop app was previously named "Codeply Craft" and its bot product "Codeply Crew"; both are now features of Codeply (Code, Agents, Design).

## Products

- [Codeply Craft](https://codeply.app/craft): The desktop coding agent. Builds the feature, checks it in a real browser at desktop, tablet and phone sizes, and fixes what is broken. Click Cloud and it keeps going on GitHub while your PC is off, then opens a pull request.
- [Codeply Crew](https://codeply.app/crew): Bots you make in one sentence. They handle the inbox, the calendar and follow-ups, remember what you tell them, and call or text you when they need you.
- [Codeply Mobile](https://codeply.app/mobile): The phone app. Start a run on your PC or in the cloud, check the result, merge it and take calls from your bots.
- [Codeply CLI](https://codeply.app/cli): The same agent in your terminal. Reads your code, edits files, runs commands and checks its own work. Supports plugins, MCP servers and Ollama models.
- [Codeply Studio](https://codeply.app/studio): VS Code with the Codeply agent in the side panel: Ctrl+K edits in place, Tab autocomplete, every step asks first.
- [Codeply Drop](https://codeply.app/drop): Press Alt+C (Option+C on Mac) in any app and Codeply opens in the corner of your screen. Included with Craft.

## Get started

- [Download](https://codeply.app/download): Codeply for Windows and macOS, the phone app, and the CLI install commands. Free to start.
- [Documentation](https://codeply.app/docs): Install, sign in, the hotkey, the write box and file detection.
- [Changelog](https://codeply.app/changelog): Every release, newest first.
